name: Curexo
description: Curexo, Inc. is a medical robotics company based in Seoul, South Korea. After acquiring the [ROBODOC](/robot/iss_robodoc) orthopedic business from [Integrated Surgical Systems](/company/integrated_surgical_systems) (operated in the U.S. through its subsidiary [Think Surgical](/company/think_surgical)), Curexo developed the [CUVIS-joint](/robot/curexo_cuvis_joint) arthroplasty robot and the [CUVIS-spine](/robot/curexo_cuvis_spine) spinal navigation system.
